vector_encoding: ordered float64 values in feature_names order

context_rules.placeholder_language: Case-insensitive Unicode-NFC word match for demo, dummy, example, fake, fixture, mock, nonprod, placeholder, sample, synthetic, test, or testing in the key/before/after context fields.
context_rules.nearby_occurrence: Unicode-NFC exact candidate occurrence in the key/before/after fields; the candidate-bearing primary context line is excluded.

shape_rules.base64_like: At least 16 base64/base64url characters with optional up-to-two padding characters and at least two digits or base64-special characters.

future_handoff: Feature goldens, grouped false-positive audit, and owner review must occur before Rust parity migration or fusion use.
